turns.text: Hi. The print was delivered to the old flat. I'd like to change the delivery address on that order now.
I’m sorry the print went to your old flat. Could you send the order number and the email you used to place the order? I’ll check what options are available.
Order SC-5209, email cressida.paunelu@example.com. The new delivery address would be Lindenweg 9, Graz.
I’m sorry the print went to your old flat. The delivery address can only be changed before the order ships, so I couldn’t update it. A colleague will take over to see what options are available.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer cressida.paunelu@example.com reports print delivered to old flat and wants delivery changed to Lindenweg 9, Graz. Policy blocks change after shipping; no change filed. Please review available options.
